info.name: SoundCloud - Phosphor Vector | Retro Hacker Green
info.description: Turn SoundCloud into a glowing retro terminal with neon-green text, deep black-and-forest panels, CRT scan lines, wireframe vector grids and vivid green hover halos. Navigation, search controls, buttons, track lists, album-cover hover borders, playlists, menus, SoundCloud branding and scrollbars adopt one consistent green phosphor palette. The bottom player uses a luminous green CSS waveform-style progress indicator that fills as SoundCloud playback advances.
